brand.model: FOFO — Franchise-owned, franchise-operated. Partner invests and runs the store.
brand.summary: Eyewear & optical, FOFO. Ideal space 250–600 sq ft; partner capital needed ₹35L / ₹25L / ₹20L (Tier 1/2/3).

metrics.label: Financial readiness
metrics.what: Can the partner fund the store? Investment is compared with the eyewear & optical setup cost for the city tier: ₹35L / ₹25L / ₹20L (Tier 1/2/3).
levels: Relies on a loan (from the notes)

metrics.label: Real-estate economics
metrics.what: Will the store make money after rent? Capital cover plus whether the space is owned.

metrics.label: Floor & accessibility
metrics.what: Walk-in access. This format needs street-level visibility.
levels: Mall unit (good fit for this category)

metrics.label: Space size & format fit
metrics.what: Does the space fit the store format? Ideal 250–600 sq ft; workable 200–900.
levels: Far too small or too big

metrics.label: Space ownership
metrics.what: Who controls the space, and for how long.
levels: Not yet identified — caps the decision at Conditional

metrics.label: Operating experience
metrics.what: Can they run a shop? Years of retail experience, boosted when their business is related to eyewear & optical.

metrics.label: Local nuance & intent
metrics.what: Fit with local customers and staff, averaged with how serious the notes sound.

metrics.label: Strategic fit & slots
metrics.what: How much the brand wants this territory now, and how many slots are left.

metrics.label: Demographic density
metrics.what: Population and spending power, from the city tier and the type of locality.

metrics.label: Purchase triggers (JTBD)
metrics.what: How strongly the spot triggers a purchase — busy streets, transit, malls.

metrics.label: Supply-chain reach
metrics.what: How easily stock reaches the store from the existing network.

metrics.label: Cannibalisation vs. white space
metrics.what: Would it eat into an existing store, or open fresh ground?

metrics.label: Speed to market
metrics.what: How soon they can open. Realistic lead time is ~2 months with a space, ~4 without.

→ Hold on the waitlist (if any application in the batch is inside the plan).
